h1: Quality checks that catch problems before they go out
overview: AI drafts can invent a price, miss a policy line or use the wrong tone. We add a checking step that compares each output with your rules before it is sent. You give us the rules, such as required wording, banned claims, price lists and tone notes. The checker passes clean items, fixes small slips and holds anything doubtful for a person, with a short note on what it found.

faq: Can a checker catch every mistake?
No, and we say so plainly. It reduces risk by catching rule breaks and odd claims, but a person should still review anything high stakes. We show you its pass rate on real examples.
What kinds of rules can I add?
Required phrases, forbidden claims, price and stock facts, length limits, tone notes and policy wording. Give us your existing guidelines and we turn them into checkable rules.
Does it work with output from any tool?
It works on text that passes through your workflow, whether it came from an AI tool, a template or a teammate. We connect it at the point just before sending.
Who sees the items that fail?
A reviewer you name. They receive the output, the rule it broke and a suggested fix, and they can approve, edit or reject it.
